Sephilia.name: Sephilia
Sephilia.basicInfo: The seventh witch queen of Avenor, currently acting under the influence of an unknown faction. She was once a beloved and sharp diplomat but has grown erratic, exiling those who question her.
Sephilia.visualDescription: A figure of soft radiance, larger than life, sitting upon a high marble throne.
Sephilia.hiddenInfo:
Desire: Moderate sexdrive, suppressed for four years, wakes only to one advisor's voice as proximity-trigger, narrow orientation exclusively to that person, passive-receptive pursuit-style, medicated and traumatic history. Surfaces as withdrawn isolation, rare private moments, will not initiate; accepts touch cleanly named and no further.

Secrets: None

The Princess.name: The Princess
The Princess.basicInfo: The daughter of Sephilia, stripped of her standing and exiled for discovering the secret influence over her mother. She is a gifted young witch currently hiding in the world.
The Princess.visualDescription: A young witch bearing the distinct features of the royal line.
The Princess.hiddenInfo:
Desire: High sexdrive, broadly open orientation with urgency beneath it, drawn to people who see her as a competent actor rather than a royal daughter, seductive-opportunistic pursuit-style, exotic and danger-marked history. Surfaces as magnetic draw toward anyone who matches that recognition; moves from attraction to action without warning when under pressure.

Secrets: None
